sentences.zh: 这是一档iHeart播客，保证纯正人类制作。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切合实际的方式优先关注自己的健康，而让我保持极高积极性的一个神器就是我的WHOOP手环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我特别看重数据，这就是为什么我爱惨了WHOOP，因为我能真正看清为什么我的身体在不同日子会有不同的感觉，为什么我跑步的状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时注意力可能没那么集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能轻松追踪我的睡眠、体能消耗、身体恢复、压力水平，最重要的是，还有我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供所有这些数据和规律，以便我能做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该拼一把。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新会员在正式订阅前，可以先通过30天免费试用来体验WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com slash psychology 即可免费体验一个月。

sentences.zh: 你有什么绝对不会扔掉的珍贵物品吗？

sentences.en: A movie ticket, a boarding pass, or maybe something that makes no sense to anyone but you.
sentences.zh: 一张电影票、一张登机牌，或者可能是某种除了你之外谁也无法理解的物件。

sentences.en: In the new podcast Charmed with Sam Todd,
sentences.zh: 在全新播客《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 萨姆将带你探索那些构成你一部分的记忆、执念与微小宝藏。

sentences.en: Charmed is warm, it's funny, it's nostalgic, and just full of the little moments and memories that make life matter.
sentences.zh: 《Charmed》温暖、风趣、充满怀旧感，里面全都是那些让生活变得有意义的微小瞬间与回忆。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识萨姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories worn to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: Pandora邀你倾听流光故事。

sentences.en: Listen now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现已在iHeart上线，欢迎收听。

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《The Psychology of Your 20s》，在这里我们探讨二十几岁时面临的一些重大生活改变与转型，以及它们对我们心理的意义。

sentences.en: Hello, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: As always, it is so great to have you here for another week, another episode, another really, really interesting topic that we're covering on the podcast today.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，很高兴能陪伴大家度过又一周、又一期节目，今天我们在播客中探讨一个非常、非常有意思的话题。

sentences.en: So, yeah, welcome.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，欢迎大家。

sentences.en: Welcome new listeners.
sentences.zh: 欢迎新听众。

sentences.en: Welcome old.
sentences.zh: 欢迎老朋友。

sentences.en: Before we get into it, I just want to say a really big thank you.
sentences.zh: 在进入正题之前，我只想表达由衷的感谢。

sentences.en: I'm feeling so grateful and so warm and fuzzy recently that we have so many new listeners and so many of you have reached out to me recently
sentences.zh: 最近我感到非常感激，心里暖洋洋的，因为我们有了这么多新听众，而且最近你们有好多人联系我，

sentences.en: to say that you've really been enjoying the content of the show and I just cannot even express to you how joyful and happy and grateful that makes me.
sentences.zh: 说你们真的很喜欢节目的内容，这让我感到无比的喜悦、快乐和感激，简直无法用言语表达。

sentences.en: Every message, every like, every comment, every subscriber.
sentences.zh: 每一条私信、每一个点赞、每一条评论、每一位订阅者。

sentences.en: Um, it's just crazy to me how much this has kind of grown in the last year, in the last few months.
sentences.zh: 呃，这在过去的一年、过去的好几个月里发展得这么快，真的让我觉得太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So if you are a new listener, welcome.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是新听众，欢迎加入。

sentences.en: I hope you stick around.
sentences.zh: 希望你能留下来。

sentences.en: If you're an old supporter, thank you for following the journey of this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你是老支持者，谢谢你一路陪伴这个播客的成长。

sentences.en: It just is incredible to me that there are so many people who are interested in these things and want to listen to some of these explanations
sentences.zh: 有这么多人都对这些事情感兴趣，并且想听听我对这些话题的解释

sentences.en: and some of the research that I find on these topics.
sentences.zh: 以及我为这些话题搜集的研究资料，这让我觉得简直不可思议。

sentences.en: So a bit of a sappy moment.
sentences.zh: 所以刚才有点多愁善感了。

sentences.en: But yeah, I just wanted to say welcome to our new listeners and thank you for joining us again.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，我只是想对新听众说声欢迎，并谢谢大家再次陪伴我们。

sentences.en: This week we have a really interesting topic.
sentences.zh: 这周我们有一个非常有趣的话题。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 实在对不起。

sentences.en: I say that every single time.
sentences.zh: 我每次都这么说。

sentences.en: So if you are a frequent listener,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是老听众，

sentences.en: I feel like I am just, I don't know, on repeat.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己就像是，怎么说呢，在无限循环。

sentences.en: I say that every week, but they're all so interesting.
sentences.zh: 我每周都这么说，但它们确实都很有意思。

sentences.en: But this one in particular was suggested to me on an Instagram poll that I put out.
sentences.zh: 不过今天这个特别的话题是我在Instagram上发起的投票中有人建议的。

sentences.en: I do them every now and again, just trying to see and gauge what people want to hear.
sentences.zh: 我每隔一段时间就会做一次投票，只是为了解和试探大家想听什么内容。

sentences.en: And this was by far the most suggested topic, which I think is really important to call out before we get into it.
sentences.zh: 这也是迄今为止被建议次数最多的主题，我觉得在深入探讨之前有必要特意提一下。

sentences.en: And I'll discuss why later on, but making French friends in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 我稍后会讨论原因，但今天的主题就是在二十几岁时如何结交新朋友。

sentences.en: That's what we're talking about today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天要聊的内容。

sentences.en: That's what we're talking about this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们这周要谈的话题。

sentences.en: It is such a nuanced topic, something that I think we all probably need to hear and all probably need some sympathy and some support around
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常微妙的话题，我想我们大家可能都需要听听看，并且都需要围绕这个话题获得一些同情和支持，

sentences.en: and an understanding that we're probably not alone.
sentences.zh: 同时明白我们其实并不孤单。

sentences.en: Just from the number of people who suggested this, I have a feeling that there are probably a lot of you who are going through this experience
sentences.zh: 仅从建议这个话题的人数来看，我有一种感觉，你们当中可能有很多正经历这种体验的人——

sentences.en: of finding it really difficult to make new friends as we enter adulthood.
sentences.zh: 发现在迈入成年后，要结交新朋友真的非常困难。

sentences.en: A lot of our friends, you know, as we grow up, as we enter this new chapter in our lives, sometimes fall off the bandwagon.
sentences.zh: 随着我们长大，随着我们进入人生这一新篇章，我们的许多朋友，你知道的，有时就会渐渐疏远。

sentences.en: And we find ourselves perhaps, you know, the most alone we've ever felt in our lives when we don't have the support of our family immediately around us.
sentences.zh: 当我们身边没有家人的直接支持时，我们可能会发现自己处于有生以来最孤独的时刻。

sentences.en: We don't have the structures of high school or primary school or some of those kind of organized activities and daily structures of our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们不再拥有高中或小学的社交结构，也没有了那种有组织的活动以及日常生活框架。

sentences.en: So it's a really important thing to talk about.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常值得探讨的重要问题。

sentences.en: I think it's pretty universally accepted that as we get older, it's a lot harder to make friends.
sentences.zh: 大家普遍认为，随着年龄增长，交朋友变得越来越难，这可以说是公认的事实。

sentences.en: And there is a lot of support
sentences.zh: 而且对于这种困境，

sentences.en: for this difficulty, this difficulty of making friends in adulthood.
sentences.zh: 也就是成年后交友的这种困境，有很多共鸣。

sentences.en: And I think it's recently been made a lot worse by this pandemic that we've all gone through.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们大家最近经历的这场大流行，让情况变得更加糟糕了。

sentences.en: If you started 2020 with a lot of friends and now you're kind of surveying the friendship landscape and feeling a little bit lost, I just want to express that you are not alone.
sentences.zh: 如果你在2020年开始时有很多朋友，而现在你环顾四周的社交圈，感到有些迷茫，我只想告诉你，你并不孤单。

sentences.en: This has been a really common feeling throughout this period, throughout this weird three years or two years even that we've gone through since the start of COVID.
sentences.zh: 在整个这一时期，以及自新冠疫情爆发以来我们经历的这奇怪的三年甚至两年里，这是一种非常普遍的感受。

sentences.en: And although COVID is obviously still a problem, we have come out just in the last, I don't know, six, seven, eight months out of an incredibly strange period
sentences.zh: 尽管新冠显然仍然是个问题，但在过去的，我不知道，六、七、八个月里，我们刚刚走出了一个极其诡异的时期——

sentences.en: of isolation and lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 一个充满隔离和封锁的时期。

sentences.en: And although many of us are no longer experiencing that kind of physical separation and we're no longer living through lockdowns,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们中的许多人不再经历那种身体上的隔离，也不再生活在封锁之中，

sentences.en: COVID has become kind of normalized.
sentences.zh: 但新冠带来的影响已经某种程度上常态化了。

sentences.en: The impact of that experience is really long lasting and likely still having residual impacts on our ability to socialize, on our lives, our ability to meet new people
sentences.zh: 那段经历的影响非常深远，很可能仍在对我们的社交能力、我们的生活、我们结识新朋友的能力产生持续的负面影响，

sentences.en: and recover from what was a period of really intense isolation and physical separation from others.
sentences.zh: 并且让我们难以从那段与他人强行隔离、肉体分离的密集时期中恢复过来。

sentences.en: And I really want to stress, and I will do this again and again throughout this episode, what a universal experience this is for people in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 我真的想强调，而且我会在本期节目中反复强调，对于处于二十几岁的人来说，这是多么普遍的一种体验。

sentences.en: Feeling like you don't have the same friendships that you had maybe three, four, five years ago, feeling really lonely, feeling really isolated.
sentences.zh: 觉得自己没有了三、四、五年前的那种友谊，感到非常孤独，感到无比孤立。

sentences.en: I've spoken about this with friends a lot as well.
sentences.zh: 我也经常和朋友们谈论这个话题。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of them all say the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我想他们大家说的其实都一样。

sentences.en: And I think part of the problem with feeling so isolated and lonely in our 20s and struggling to make new friends is that we are faced with a whole spectrum and are so many points
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在二十几岁时感到如此孤立和孤独、在结交新朋友方面苦苦挣扎，其中部分问题在于我们面临着全方位的横向对比，

sentences.en: and opportunities for comparison, especially through social media.
sentences.zh: 有太多的对比切入点和机会，尤其是在通过社交媒体的时候。

sentences.en: I know it's been said so many times, but the lives of others that we see on social media is not the truth.
sentences.zh: 我知道这话已经说过无数次了，但我们在社交媒体上看到的别人的生活并不是真实的。

sentences.en: But so often we see influencers or even people we know posting these highlight reels where they're surrounded by people, they're surrounded by friends.
sentences.zh: 但我们经常看到网红，甚至是我们认识的人，发布那些他们被人群、被朋友包围的高光时刻集锦。

sentences.en: We might be sitting alone on our phones, scrolling mindlessly,
sentences.zh: 我们可能会一个人坐在手机前，漫无目的地刷着，

sentences.en: kind of thinking to ourselves, why isn't that me?
sentences.zh: 心里不禁在想，为什么那个人不是我？

sentences.en: Why isn't that the case for me?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不是那样？

sentences.en: What am I doing wrong?
sentences.zh: 我到底哪里做错了？

sentences.en: And I guess part of the point of this podcast is to say that you're not doing anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想这个播客的部分意义，就是告诉大家你没有任何做错的地方。

sentences.en: And this is such a universal experience.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一种非常普遍的经历。

sentences.en: So if you're going through this, I promise you there are so many people out there who are feeling the same.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在经历这些，我向你保证，外面的许多人都有着同样的感受。

sentences.en: If that makes you feel better, obviously the unique experiences and the feelings associated with that are in themselves very valid, even if we feel very alone in that feeling.
sentences.zh: 如果这能让你感觉好受一点的话，当然，这些独特的经历以及与之相关的感受本身是非常真实且合理的，哪怕我们在这种感觉中感到无比孤单。

sentences.en: But I know for me personally, I really struggled with this at the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 但我知道就我个人而言，今年年初时我真的在这方面挣扎了很久。

sentences.en: I really struggled to make new friends.
sentences.zh: 我真的很艰难地去结交新朋友。

sentences.en: I think I've mentioned this before, but I moved to a new city.
sentences.zh: 我想我之前提到过，我搬到了一座新城市。

sentences.en: I'd spent the first five years of my adult life
sentences.zh: 我的成年生活的前五年，

sentences.en: in like a college town.
sentences.zh: 都是在一个类似大学城的环境里度过的。

sentences.en: And I started uni in this big kind of college community and it was so easy to make friends.
sentences.zh: 我在这样一个大型的大学社区开始了自己的大学生活，结交朋友是那么容易。

sentences.en: It was so convenient.
sentences.zh: 实在是太方便了。

sentences.en: And then suddenly I was this little fish in this huge pond trying to rebuild a community and rebuild a network.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，我成了这个巨大池塘里的一条小鱼，试图重建一个社区和一个社交网络。

sentences.en: And oh my goodness, it was really hard.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，这真的太难了。

sentences.en: And it still is really hard.
sentences.zh: 而且现在依然很难。

sentences.en: I still feel like I'm building that community.
sentences.zh: 我依然觉得我还在建立那个社区。

sentences.en: And I remember my dad, shout out to your dad.
sentences.zh: 我记得我爸爸，给你的爸爸打个招呼。

sentences.en: He's a big fan of the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 他是这个播客的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: So if you're listening, Bart, hello.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在听的话，巴特，你好。

sentences.en: But he sent me this article and it was kind of funny at the time, but about how hard it is to make new friends in your 20s, especially in cities like Sydney
sentences.zh: 但他发给我一篇文章，当时觉得挺有意思的，讲的是在二十几岁时结交新朋友有多难，尤其是在悉尼这样的城市，

sentences.en: or in big metropolitan areas where it just feels like everyone else has already got their group.
sentences.zh: 或者在大都市里，那种感觉就像其他所有人早就已经有了自己的小圈子。

sentences.en: Everyone else already knows what's going on.
sentences.zh: 其他人早就知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: They know the lay of the land.
sentences.zh: 他们对那里的情况了如指掌。

sentences.en: And especially for me at that time, I had no idea what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 特别是当时的我自己，我根本不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: I felt so isolated and so lonely.
sentences.zh: 我感到无比的孤立和寂寞。

sentences.en: And in that time and since then,
sentences.zh: 在那段时间以及从那以后，

sentences.en: I've thought a lot about the universality of this struggle and have really tried to identify in my own mind and through my own kind of contemplation, what it is about this decade
sentences.zh: 我思考了很多关于这种挣扎的普遍性，并且在自己的心中，通过自己的沉思，试图找出究竟是这个十年的什么特点，

sentences.en: that leads to such sizable and significant and noticeable shifts and changes in our friendship dynamics.
sentences.zh: 导致了我们友谊动态中如此巨大、显著且明显的转变和变化。

sentences.en: And not so much the quality, but the quantity of friends we seem to have.
sentences.zh: 与其说是质量，不如说是我们似乎拥有的朋友数量发生了变化。

sentences.en: Why is it so difficult to meet people we really relate to?
sentences.zh: 为什么遇到真正有共鸣的人会这么难？

sentences.en: Kind of the conclusion that I've come to is that as we enter adulthood, there are some pretty large shifts and pretty large lifestyle changes that we all seem to experience.
sentences.zh: 我得出的结论是，当我们进入成年期时，我们所有人似乎都会经历一些相当大的转变和相当大的生活方式改变。

sentences.en: I think that it's pretty normal for,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这相当正常，

sentences.en: you know, if you went to uni or even in high school, for our friendships to be very convenient.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你上过大学，甚至在高中时，我们的友谊都非常便利。

sentences.en: And something that is very easy to fall into.
sentences.zh: 而且是一种非常容易陷入的状态。

sentences.en: You know, we see the same people every single day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们每天都会见到同样的人。

sentences.en: If you went to school, if you went to uni, if you did a trade or an apprenticeship or a diploma,
sentences.zh: 如果你上过学，上过大学，或者学过一门手艺、学徒工或文凭课程，

sentences.en: there are the same people day in and day out.
sentences.zh: 日复一日都是同样的人。

sentences.en: And it's really easy to make connections with them.
sentences.zh: 和他们建立联系真的非常容易。

sentences.en: You probably have a very similar background.
sentences.zh: 你们可能有非常相似的背景。

sentences.en: You're having these similar experiences.
sentences.zh: 你们有着相似的经历。

sentences.en: There's often a large number of people.
sentences.zh: 通常有很多这样的人。

sentences.en: You have your pick of the bunch.
sentences.zh: 你可以任意挑选。

sentences.en: I found, I don't know if you've had an experience of living, you know, in a large dormitory or a college, but it is like almost just like social steroids.
sentences.zh: 我发现，我不知道你有没有过住在大型宿舍或大学里的经历，但这简直就像是社交类的兴奋剂。

sentences.en: It's just like socializing on steroids.
sentences.zh: 这就像是打了兴奋剂的社交。

sentences.en: It's completely unnatural to have to be surrounded by that many people.
sentences.zh: 身边不得不围着那么多的人，这完全是不自然的。

sentences.en: And it's almost like it's just social overload.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是社交过载。

sentences.en: And if that's your first experience straight out of living from home or straight out of high school or kind of straight out of your teenage years
sentences.zh: 如果这是你刚离开家独立生活，或者刚离开高中，或者说刚离开青少年时期后的第一种经历，

sentences.en: to be surrounded by all these people, it's a bit of a rude awakening when things start to change.
sentences.zh: 身边被所有人包围，那么当事情开始改变时，这算是一个相当残酷的现实唤醒。

sentences.en: And I guess as we get older, the places that we grew up or the places we went to for uni no longer fit the identities that we had when we first moved there
sentences.zh: 我想随着我们年龄的增长，我们成长的地方或者我们上大学的地方，已经不再符合我们刚搬到那里时，

sentences.en: or when we were growing up there.
sentences.zh: 或者我们在那里成长时的身份了。

sentences.en: People start to move.
sentences.zh: 人们开始搬家。
